meta_description:
37K likes, 506 comments - greatness on October 15, 2026: "there’s only one reason you’re stressed. 🖤

@tonyrobbins says it’s because you’re managing your circumstances instead of creating your life.

managing feels like holding on. maintaining. just trying to get by. creating feels like building something, and there’s no fear in that.

courage doesn’t mean you’re not scared. it means you’re scared and you do it anyway, trusting it’s all leading somewhere greater.

send this to someone who’s been in survival mode way too long 👇

#schoolofgreatness #tonyrobbins #mindset #faith #personalgrowth".
